name: sequence-circuit
description: Verification-oriented compiler for ISO pneumatic and hydraulic circuits. The model proposes YAML; the compiler authorizes sheets.

com.openai.interface.longDescription: Sequence Circuit is a verification-oriented compiler for electropneumatic and hydraulic sequence circuits. A language model may propose YAML. The compiler decides whether that YAML is allowed to become a sheet. Fail-closed draw, independent spec_trace vs env_trace, discrete TIMER ticks, cascade grouping with electrical step-memory, and explicit UNSUPPORTED for pressure waits. Logical checks only — not a machine-safety certificate. No accounts. YAML is not stored. Physics and pressure drop are refused.
starterPrompts: Draw A+ B+ B- A- with two 5/2 double-solenoid valves.
Add a 2 second wait after clamp, then feed and return.
Refuse a magic_valve and explain the sentence.
